ui.collectionSubtitle: Make your icons part of the landscape.
ui.autostartTitle: Run Deskland automatically when you sign in
ui.autostartBlocked: Start with Windows may have been blocked
ui.autostartWarnSw: Deskland didn't start automatically this time — {sw} may have blocked it. Open {sw}, find Deskland in its startup manager and set it to Allow.
ui.autostartWarnGeneric: Deskland didn't start automatically this time — your security software or the Windows Startup apps setting may have blocked it. Turn Deskland on in your security software's startup manager, or in Windows Settings → Apps → Startup.
ui.updateVersion: Deskland {version} is ready. Your current theme and settings will be kept.
ui.updateCompleted: The update has been downloaded and installed. If Deskland does not restart automatically, open it again.
ui.updateCanceled: The update was canceled. You can try again later.
ui.updateLowBattery: The update could not finish on battery power. Plug in your device and try again.
ui.updateWifiRecommended: This network may incur charges. Switch networks or try again later.
ui.updateWifiRequired: Connect to Wi-Fi to download this update.
ui.updateStoreRequired: This update method is only available in the Microsoft Store edition.
ui.updateFailed: The update failed. Check your connection or Microsoft Store and try again.
ui.updateChecking: Connecting to the update server and checking for a new version…
ui.networkTimeout: The connection or download timed out. Check your network, proxy or firewall and try again. If other websites work, the server may also be responding slowly.
ui.networkDns: The server address couldn't be resolved. Check your network, DNS or proxy settings and try again.
ui.networkTls: A secure connection couldn't be established. Check the system time and any security interception by your network or proxy, then try again.
ui.networkLocal: The network connection failed or was interrupted. Check your network, proxy or firewall and try again.
ui.serverUnavailable: The server was reached, but the service is temporarily unavailable (HTTP 5xx). Please try again later.
ui.serverRejected: The server rejected the request (HTTP 4xx). Try again later or contact support if this continues.
ui.serverInvalid: The server returned an unrecognized response. Try again later or contact support if this continues.
ui.downloadInvalid: The download was incomplete or failed security verification, so installation was stopped. Try again or contact support if this keeps happening.
ui.previewIcons: Live preview · using the {n} icons on your desktop
ui.previewNoIcons: Live preview · desktop icons are hidden
ui.refreshTitle: Generate a new scene for this theme
ui.shareImageTitle: Share your desktop image while protecting your privacy
ui.shareVideoTitle: Share your desktop animation while protecting your privacy
ui.sharePrivacy: Icons are replaced with sample icons and file names with color blocks, so none of your files are shown.
ui.shareCopiedImage: The image is on your clipboard — paste it straight into a chat or a post.
ui.shareCopiedVideo: The video file is on your clipboard — paste it into a chat window to send it.
ui.autosave: Changes are saved automatically and applied to your desktop right away
ui.resetAllTitle: Reset all settings of this theme to their defaults
ui.helpWallpaperQ: Deskland keeps flickering or restarting. How do I fix it?
ui.helpWallpaperA: If your regular Windows wallpaper changes automatically, each change can make Deskland flicker or restart. Use a fixed background that does not rotate.
ui.helpWallpaperStep2: Set ‘Personalize your background’ to ‘Picture’ or ‘Solid color’. Do not use ‘Slideshow’ or ‘Windows spotlight’.
ui.helpWallpaperStep3: Restart Deskland after changing this setting.
ui.monitorsHint: Pick a monitor to give it its own wallpaper, or All monitors to change them all
ui.lockedTitle: {name} · Wallpaper edition theme; click for purchase details
ui.purchaseLocalTheme: “{name}” is included in the Wallpaper edition.
ui.purchaseLocalMessage: After you buy from the current store, Deskland verifies your purchase and unlocks it automatically—no account sign-in needed. If you just bought it, check again.
ui.ongoingDesc: New scenes and elements will be added over time.
ui.noParams: This theme has no settings yet
ui.purchaseTheme: “{name}” is included in the Wallpaper edition.
ui.purchaseMessage: The preview includes Beach and Meadow forever. Get the Wallpaper edition to unlock more themes in the same Deskland app.

host.welcomeBody:
Click the beach icon in the system tray{hotkey} to open the menu.
Can't see it? Click ^ on the right side of the taskbar.
host.errBusyImage: The previous image is still being generated
host.errBusyVideo: The previous clip is still recording
host.errRebuilt: Windows kept rebuilding the wallpaper layer, so Deskland has stopped.
host.errNoDesktop: Couldn't find the desktop window, so the wallpaper can't be attached.

beach.name: Beach
beach.desc: The shoreline curves around your files as waves roll up the sand

palms.label: Coconut palms
palms.hint: Number of coastal palms; 0 to hide. Fewer appear if there is not enough sand.

sigma.label: Distance from icons
sigma.hint: How far the shoreline sits from your icons

warp.label: Winding coast
warp.hint: How much the shoreline twists and turns

shoal.label: Clear shallows
shoal.hint: How wide the see-through water over the sand is

shallow.label: Shallow sea
shallow.hint: How far the water fades from turquoise to deep blue

audio.label: React to sound
audio.hint: Waves rise and fall with whatever your PC is playing: bass lifts the swell, mids whip up the spray. Sound is analyzed locally; the microphone is never used.

meadow.name: Meadow
meadow.desc: A pen-and-wash meadow where your icons hide in white clouds that cast dark green shadows

sigma.label: Cloud size
sigma.hint: How far the clouds around your icons spread out

cover.label: Clouds over the meadow
cover.hint: How many clouds drift over the open meadow

flow.label: Drift speed
flow.hint: How fast the clouds drift and their puffs change

showBoy.label: Show boy
showBoy.hint: Show or hide the boy together with his kite

showCat.label: Show kitten
showCat.hint: The little black kitten resting on the grass

audio.label: React to sound
audio.hint: Grass sways with the volume, clouds puff on the beat and the bass sends a gust to the kite. Sound is analyzed locally; the microphone is never used.

space.name: Space
space.desc: Your icons gather glowing nebulae and star clusters, while planets rest in open deep space and meteors and rockets drift by

sigma.label: Nebula reach
sigma.hint: How far the nebula around your icons spreads out

glow.label: Nebula brightness
glow.hint: How brightly the nebula glows; 0 leaves only the stars

stars.label: Star density
stars.hint: How many background stars and twinkling bright stars appear

flow.label: Animation speed
flow.hint: How fast stars twinkle, moons orbit and spacecraft fly

planets.label: Planets
planets.hint: Number of planets resting in open space; 0 to hide. Fewer appear if there is not enough room.

meteors.label: Meteors
meteors.hint: How often shooting stars streak across; 0 to hide

ships.label: Spacecraft
ships.hint: Rockets and satellites slowly crossing the screen

desk.name: Desk
desk.desc: A wooden desk seen from above: icons sit on sticky notes and paper, coffee steams, shadows follow the time of day and a cat walks from one screen to the next

wood.label: Wood
wood.hint: Which wood the desk is made of

light.label: Light
light.hint: When following the clock, shadows and window light slowly change with your computer's time; at night only the desk lamp remains

notes.label: Paper
notes.hint: Whether your icons sit on sticky notes or sheets of paper

items.label: Stationery
items.hint: Notebook, pencils, glasses, eraser and paper clips; 0 to hide. Fewer appear if there is not enough room.

cat.label: Cat
cat.hint: A cat strolls across the desk; with several monitors it walks from one screen to the next

ide.name: Code Editor
ide.desc: Your desktop becomes a dark code editor with icons as selected blocks; a cursor types new code, fixes the odd typo, and several monitors form one file

lang.label: Language
lang.hint: Which language the made-up code is written in

typing.label: Typing
typing.hint: A cursor types new code in open space, sometimes with a red squiggle that gets fixed

minimap.label: Minimap
minimap.hint: The slowly scrolling code overview on the far right

terminal.name: Retro Terminal
terminal.desc: A phosphor terminal: icons live in ASCII windows while build, test and deploy logs scroll around them, with the occasional ASCII art

phosphor.label: Phosphor
phosphor.hint: The glow color of an old monitor

crt.label: CRT effect
crt.hint: How strong the scanlines, vignette and text glow are

speed.label: Scroll speed
speed.hint: How fast commands and logs appear

art.label: ASCII art
art.hint: How often cats, rockets and other ASCII art appear

gitgraph.name: Git Graph
gitgraph.desc: A commit graph as scenery: icons are commits and branches wind around them; main runs across every monitor while new branches grow and merge back

labels.label: Labels
labels.hint: Commit hashes, branch names and version tags

activity.label: New branches
activity.hint: How often a branch grows in open space, gains commits and merges back into main

pulses.label: Pulses
pulses.hint: Glowing dots flowing along main; with several monitors they travel from one screen to the next

ast.name: Syntax Tree
ast.desc: Your icons become nodes of an abstract syntax tree branching downward; a parser lights them up in order, and several monitors hang under one Program

density.label: Branch density
density.hint: How many small nodes grow in open space

values.label: Names and values
values.hint: Show names and values on Identifier and Literal nodes

speed.label: Parse speed
speed.hint: How fast the parser lights up nodes

strip.label: Source strip
strip.hint: The line of tokens at the bottom, highlighted in step with the parser

dashboard.name: System Dashboard
dashboard.desc: This PC's live CPU, per-core heatmap, memory, network and disk fill the open space; icon alerts turn from green to yellow to red as load rises

range.label: Time range
range.hint: How much recent history the charts and heatmap show

refresh.label: Refresh
refresh.hint: How often the panels redraw; longer saves power

alerts.label: Icon alerts
alerts.hint: Icon borders turn from green to yellow to red with CPU and memory load

pond.name: Koi Pond
pond.desc: Your icons float on lily pads while koi glide beneath; with music, ripples and bubbles keep the beat

koi.label: Koi
koi.hint: How many koi swim in the pond; 0 to hide

pads.label: Floating lilies
pads.hint: How many lily pads drift on the open water (pads under icons are not affected)

flow.label: Swim speed
flow.hint: How fast the koi swim and the light ripples drift

audio.label: React to sound
audio.hint: Bass and beats send ripples and startle the koi, highs make bubbles, and louder music brightens the light. Sound is analyzed locally; the microphone is never used.

albumTint.label: Album colors
albumTint.hint: Tint the lotus flowers and underwater light with the cover colors of what is playing

nightcity.name: Night City
nightcity.desc: Your icons hang on skyscraper walls; with music, the whole city lights up by frequency and neon signs flash on the beat

rain.label: Rain
rain.hint: How hard it rains; with sound on, louder music brings heavier rain. 0 for no rain

neon.label: Neon signs
neon.hint: How many neon signs hang on the buildings (kept away from icons)

audio.label: React to sound
audio.hint: Each building follows one frequency band and its windows light up from the bottom with the volume; neon signs flash in turn on the beat. Sound is analyzed locally; the microphone is never used.

albumTint.label: Album colors
albumTint.hint: Tint the neon and window light with the cover colors of what is playing

showTrack.label: Rooftop billboard
showTrack.hint: Show the title and artist of what is playing on a rooftop billboard
